# ghost/gallery

Fossify Gallery (F-Droid): list albums, list photos in an album, open a photo, read its properties. Offline, read-only.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/gallery
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/gallery list_albums --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/gallery list_photos --device <serial> --param album=<album>
ghost skill run ghost/gallery open_photo --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/gallery get_photo_properties --device <serial> --param name=<name>
```

## Actions

- `list_albums`: What photo albums do I have?
- `list_photos`: Which photos are in the Camera album?
- `open_photo`: Show me the photo ghost_green.png
- `get_photo_properties`: What resolution is ghost_red.png?
